versions.subject: Merge PR #5854 from @swachchhanda000 - Add Notepad++ Infrastructure Abuse Rules
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\gup.exe'
selection_child_img:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
        - '\cscript.exe'
        - '\wscript.exe'
        - '\mshta.exe'
selection_child_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'bitsadmin'
        - 'certutil'
        - 'curl'
        - 'finger'
        - 'forfiles'
        - 'regsvr32'
        - 'rundll32'
        - 'wget'
condition: selection_parent and 1 of selection_child_*
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\gup.exe" Image IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\cscript.exe", "*\\wscript.exe", "*\\mshta.exe") OR CommandLine IN ("*bitsadmin*", "*certutil*", "*curl*", "*finger*", "*forfiles*", "*regsvr32*", "*rundll32*", "*wget*")
